purpose: P0-C characterization of legal target states and presently representable illegal states

state_rules.subject: model admission
state_rules.legal: Only accepted claims may be status=active and default-retrievable.
state_rules.current_enforcement: partial application validation; database status lacks admission-state coupling

state_rules.subject: model evidence
state_rules.legal: Every active Model has non-empty direct or transitive evidence and a source cutoff.

state_rules.subject: claim scope
state_rules.legal: Every scope entry is claim-local, typed, role-bearing, and provenance-linked.
state_rules.current_enforcement: JSONB/sidecar shape permits untyped or batch-wide scope

state_rules.subject: representation
state_rules.legal: Natural rendering and proposition bind to one immutable semantic version and digest.

state_rules.subject: falsification
state_rules.legal: A falsified Model is not active/default-retrievable and stale dependents are fenced atomically.
state_rules.current_enforcement: lifecycle transitions exist but are distributed and not transactionally closed over all readers

state_rules.subject: supersession
state_rules.legal: A superseded Model is fenced before its replacement becomes default-retrievable; incompatible dependents are retired or pending with owner.

state_rules.subject: relation admission
state_rules.legal: Only accepted, fully bound, evidenced, role-valid relation instances enter canonical relation reads.
state_rules.current_enforcement: status and participant_binding_status are independently valid columns

state_rules.subject: relation evidence
state_rules.legal: Every accepted relation has evidence event/model lineage and rationale consistent with kind/direction.
state_rules.current_enforcement: arrays may be empty; rationale consistency is application-only

state_rules.subject: relation endpoints
state_rules.legal: Accepted relation participants exist, share tenant, carry valid roles, and meet arity/direction requirements.
state_rules.current_enforcement: participant FKs protect existing rows but do not require minimum/role-complete participant sets

state_rules.subject: edge projection
state_rules.legal: Accepted binary model_edges are produced only from a validated canonical relation instance.
state_rules.current_enforcement: EdgesRepo can directly insert accepted edges

state_rules.subject: candidate isolation
state_rules.legal: Candidate/review/rejected relations never appear in default relation or edge reads.

state_rules.subject: derived-plane authority
state_rules.legal: SAGE, topology, projections, and evaluator artifacts can propose or rank but never mutate canonical truth.
state_rules.current_enforcement: module convention/import boundaries; no registered write authority

state_rules.subject: identity authority
state_rules.legal: Every alias/entity mutation carries tenant, authority, source provenance, and governed-writer identity.
state_rules.current_enforcement: repo validates core row fields but not a universal authority receipt

state_rules.subject: retrieval side effects
state_rules.legal: Retrieval counters, activation, indexes, and topology are rebuildable sidecars and cannot change semantic truth/version.

state_rules.subject: event closure
state_rules.legal: Every semantic/lifecycle mutation emits exactly one causally linked model event in the same transaction.
state_rules.current_enforcement: event emission is orchestrated by some repositories but direct SQL paths exist

current_verdict: All 15 target illegal classes are mechanically detectable by a future admission/lifecycle evaluator, but all remain representable on at least one current direct-write path. This is a P0 characterization result, not a P2 repair claim.
